$comment: One host-hook policy decision, written by _hc_observe (scripts/lib/wv-hook-observe.sh) when WV_HOOK_OBSERVATIONS names a path. A host hook decides before wv is invoked, so the record carries no wv call identity and never enters the attempt journal or the E1 denominator (policy-rules-v1 denominator, wv-bd3041): additionalProperties is false precisely so no call_id, parent_call_id or workflow identity can be attached. It is evidence that a hook-owned rule decided, which policy totality needs (wv-664b7f), not a counted call.
